entry_mode_text: SUPPRESSED - no order is issued. The regime label the report calls (TREND_UP) would have selected the TREND pivot-breakout branch with a buy-stop entry, but the suppression trigger fires first, so the row carries no entry, stop, R or TP ladder.
management_text: SUPPRESSED - no position, no management. Trigger: all accessible pivot tiers carry the single-source-indicative flag.
rationale: SUPPRESSED under the M5 10 trigger 'all accessible pivot tiers single-source-indicative' (the M5 5.2a suppression rule). Value that fired it: the report's own 11 flags every pivot tier as single-source indicative on its intraday H/L - daily ('close CORROBORATED, intraday H/L SINGLE-SOURCE INDICATIVE'), weekly (same wording) and monthly ('Intraday H/L SINGLE-SOURCE INDICATIVE'). All three timeframes are toggled on and all three are indicative, so no tier from which this card could draw an entry or stop is corroborated. M5 5.2a states the test symmetrically: if the report states anywhere that every pivot tier is indicative, the card is suppressed; and if a card were produced the report would have to show which tier is corroborated and by which second source. It does not. The report shipped the card anyway on an asserted user directive; M5 10 makes the trigger non-overridable and no run-time instruction may reverse it, so the override is removed and the SUPPRESSED row is emitted in its place. The slice cannot be used to promote a tier to corroborated here: the slice D-1 cash H/L is 7522.90 / 7462.90 against the report's 7505.30 / 7436.80, differences of 17.6 and 26.1 pts, i.e. a contradiction rather than a corroboration, and no further research is permitted. Second, independent reason the card could not be shipped as written even if the tier test passed: the TREND-branch entry formula P + 0.10 x (R1 - P) on slice daily pivots gives 7498.30 + 0.10 x (7533.70 - 7498.30) = 7498.30 + 3.54 = 7501.84, which sits 7.26 pts BELOW the reference close 7509.10 (2026-05-14 cash close). M5 5.0 requires a buy stop to sit at or above the reference close, so the breakout geometry the TREND branch prescribes is not executable as a stop today; re-labelling it a buy limit would be borrowing mean-reversion geometry into a TREND branch, which M5 5.2 calls a construction defect. For the record, and as commentary outside the card, the levels the branch would have used are: daily pivots from the D-1 cash session H 7522.90 / L 7462.90 / C 7509.10 - P 7498.30, R1 7533.70, R1.5 (R1+R2)/2 = 7546.00, R2 7558.30, S1 7473.70; stop P - 0.8 x (P - S1) = 7498.30 - 0.8 x 24.60 = 7478.62, R 23.22 pts = 0.35 x ATR14 (ATR14 = 67.01 on cash bars to 2026-05-14). No entry, stop, R or TP ladder is carried on this row. Anchor stated for completeness only: 09:00 broker (07:00 UK), the fixed daily-open anchor. Linter: SUPPRESSED row, no flags.

rationale: VARIANT SELECTION: the regime label the report itself calls is TREND_UP - 9 states 'Composite regime label is TREND_UP' and adds that the dual-gate RANGE conditions are not met; 10 and every 21b card header repeat 'TREND_UP regime'. M5 5.3 maps TREND_UP to variant 3A with no discretion, so 3A is the fork emitted here. The report shipped a 3C Momentum-Breakout headed 'TREND_UP variant', which is a variant/label mismatch that M5 5.3 calls non-compliant; 3C is a TRANSITION-only variant and in any case had no confirmed break (its own 4d test needs a close at least 0.25 x ATR14 = 16.75 pts beyond the 25-session boundary: on the slice that is 7522.90 + 16.75 = 7539.65 against a D-1 close of 7509.10). FIB SWING ANCHOR (M5 4b): starting at the default 4-session lookback (11-14 May), the most recent swing is low 7345.30 printed 2026-05-12 to high 7522.90 printed 2026-05-14; magnitude 177.60 pts = 2.65 x ATR14, which clears the 2 x ATR14 qualifying threshold at the default lookback, so no extension beyond 4 sessions was needed. The latest local high (14 May) is more recent than the latest local low (12 May), so the active swing is UP and retracements are measured low -> high, giving a long. ENTRY: 57.5% retracement (the midpoint of the 50% and 61.8% levels) = 7522.90 - 0.575 x 177.60 = 7522.90 - 102.12 = 7420.78.
